Thérèse Schwartze was the most sought-after portraitist of Dutch 19th-century high society. Yet the portraits she painted of those closest to her were her favourites.
Moses ter Borch must have been barely fifteen years old when he recorded his features on this small canvas with all the skill of an experienced master.
